result.instructions: Tools for Regsta, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is scheduled to work tomorrow, and in which department?"; "Which planned shifts were cancelled in the last two weeks?"; "How many work minutes did each employee log last week?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Regsta data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run regsta_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run regsta_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run regsta_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. regsta_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: regsta_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the company's employees with their active state, login flag, employee number, latest shift date and configured contact details (email, phone). Regsta API: GET /api/v1/employees (scope employees:read).

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: regsta_list_shifts
tools.title: List time records
tools.description: List time records (worked shifts) with their start and end times, pause and work minutes, source and status. Optional from/to dates filter by company calendar day. Regsta API: GET /api/v1/shifts (scope shifts:read).

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: regsta_list_schedule
tools.title: List planned shifts
tools.description: List the published and cancelled planned shifts (the rota) for a date range. Drafts, internal notes, cancellation reasons and vehicle plates are not returned. The range may not exceed 61 days; by default it runs from today to 13 days later. Regsta API: GET /api/v1/schedule (scope schedule:read; scheduling must be on).

from.description: First company-calendar day to include, yyyy-mm-dd. Default: today.

to.description: Last company-calendar day to include, yyyy-mm-dd. Default: 13 days after today.
